Bu hata Windows'un 'Akıllı Uygulama Dene:
This error is caused by Windows' 'Smart App Control' security feature, not a fault in SesVer. Windows blocked an unsigned library file (usually NumPy).

Solution:
  1. Open Settings (Windows key + I).
  2. Go to Privacy & security > Windows Security.
  3. Open App & browser control.
  4. Click Smart App Control settings.
  5. Select Off (answer Yes if asked for permission).
  6. Start SesVer again.

Details: AI_KURULUM.md in the SesVer folder, item 13.
